nautec.jei.bacterial_enrichment_catalyst: Place it against the side of a Cultivated Prismarine Crystal with a purity of %s or higher to raise it up to %s. It only takes a beam from the tip of a different crystal directly above or below it, and that source crystal's purity is the reference. Each cycle needs a beam of at least %s AP, spends AP and Prismatophiles colony, then raises the crystal by %s or lowers it by %s. The risk and the colony cost climb as the crystal gets purer than the source, and the catalyst stops once the crystal is %s above the source. A redstone signal pauses it.
nautec.jei.crystal_cradle: Feed the cradle laser beams of purity 2.0 or higher. After %s AP the seed becomes a Cultivated Prismarine Crystal with a random purity from 3.00 to 6.00. A Bacterial Enrichment Catalyst can raise it further, up to 12. It can be moved with a wrench without changing its purity.
nautec.jei.crystal_seed: Craft a Dormant Crystal Seed, then awaken it in a Resonance Chamber at purity 3.0. Set the awakened seed in a Crystal Cradle.
nautec.jei.cultivated_crystal: Grow a Cultivated Prismarine Crystal from an awakened seed in a Crystal Cradle. When growth finishes, its purity is randomly set between 3.00 and 6.00, compared with 3.0 for natural crystals. A Bacterial Enrichment Catalyst can raise it further, up to 12. Both output beams use this purity. The value stays the same when the crystal is moved with a wrench; its item tooltip shows the purity.

nautec.research_log.1.page.1: Day 12. The vent field east of the outpost is putting out more heat than any magma we have charted. A tap set over one of the chimney caps boiled salt water three times faster than the test rig on plain magma.
nautec.research_log.1.page.2: The chimney walls are full of ore. Copper mostly, some iron, a little gold. The tubeworms grow thickest where the water is hottest. Do not stand on a vent cap. Marcus learned that one the hard way.
nautec.research_log.1.page.3: Requesting a second Thermal Vent Tap and more Salt Water from the drains. If the readings hold, one good vent could power the whole outpost.
nautec.research_log.2.page.1: Survey of the glowing grove. The light is not only the algae. There are flooded caves under the sea bed, reached by narrow shafts, lined with polyps that glow from every wall.
nautec.research_log.2.page.2: Every cave we have entered holds a seam of budding prismarine in its floor. Clusters grow from it on their own. Someone has been down here before us: we found an old crate in the third cave.
nautec.research_log.2.page.3: Recommend we harvest crystal from the caves rather than the reef. The caves never open into dry tunnels, so they stay full of water and the crystal keeps growing.
nautec.research_log.3.page.1: The trench sounding came back at a depth we did not think possible. The pressure down there is enough to forge crystal. We have started drawings for a forge that uses the weight of the water itself.
nautec.research_log.3.page.2: Something lives in the dark below the trench rim. Large. It avoids the lights. The divers have stopped going past the second marker and I do not blame them.
nautec.research_log.3.page.3: Keep a Pressure Hatch on every module. If the hull breaches again, close it and it pumps out what came in. It saved the lab twice this month.
nautec.research_log.4.page.1: The ring structure the dive team found is not natural. It is built from prismarine and something older, and it answers to resonance. Our tuning fork made it hum.
nautec.research_log.4.page.2: If the theory is right, two rings tuned to each other could carry a diver between them in an instant. We need more power than the outpost can make to test it.
nautec.research_log.4.page.3: Final entry before the supply run. Hold is packed, modules stowed. If you are reading this and we are not back, take what you need. The sea keeps everything it is given.

nautec.submarine.hud_position.title: Sea Scout HUD Position
nautec.submarine.module.armor.desc: Plates the hull to shrug off heavier hits
nautec.submarine.module.booster.desc: Dumps the reserve into the thrusters for a short sprint
nautec.submarine.module.cargo.desc: Gives the hull a 27 slot hold, 54 with two. Fire it while piloting, or right-click the hull from behind, to open it
nautec.submarine.module.flight.desc: Lifts the hull out of the water so it flies, half again as fast as it swims
nautec.submarine.module.impulse_laser.de: Twin prismatic beams that cut whatever the nose is pointed at
nautec.submarine.module.shield.desc: Bleeds power to soak damage, and discharges to throw off boarders
nautec.submarine.module.solar.desc: Trickles the hull's cells full again in open sunlit water
nautec.submarine.module.sonar.desc: Pings the surrounding rock and lights up ore and anything hunting you
nautec.submarine.module.stealth.desc: Masks the hull so the deep stops noticing it, at the cost of speed
nautec.submarine.module.teleport.desc: Folds the water around the hull and drops it at a bound anchor
nautec.submarine.module.teleport.needs_w: The anchor has to be set in water
nautec.submarine.needs_water: The Sea Scout needs open water to launch into
nautec.submarine.oxygen: Sealed and powered, it keeps its crew breathing
nautec.tidal_rotor.status.not_ocean: Needs to be in an ocean
nautec.tool.infuse-me: Infuse in Algae Serum to unlock Abilities
nautec.tool.sword.ability: Ability: Deal 70% more damage and spawn lightnings at targets
nautec.tuning_fork.cleared: Unlinked every machine from this emitter.
nautec.tuning_fork.full: This emitter has as many machines as it can feed.
nautec.tuning_fork.loop: %s already sends power back to this emitter.
nautec.tuning_fork.lost: The emitter this fork is tuned to is gone or too far away. Tune it again.
nautec.tuning_fork.reset: The fork is no longer tuned.
nautec.tuning_fork.too_far: %s is out of the emitter's range.
nautec.tuning_fork.tooltip.usage: Right-click an emitter to tune, then machines or other emitters to link. Sneak-right-click the emitter to unlink all, or the air to forget it.
nautec.tuning_fork.tuned: Tuned to this emitter (%s machines linked). Right-click machines or other emitters to link or unlink them.
nautec.wave_jet.both_hands: The Wave Jet takes both hands
nautec.wave_jet.needs_water: The Wave Jet only bites under water
nautec.wave_jet.spotlight_hint: Toggle the spotlight with your Wave Jet key (F by default) while holding it
nautec.wrench.link.blocked: Linked, but %s at %s is in the way of the beam
nautec.wrench.link.cannot_receive: %s can't be turned to take a beam from %s
nautec.wrench.link.cannot_send: %s can't be turned to send a beam toward %s
nautec.wrench.link.cut_input: Linked, but %s turned off its old beam. Junctions turn corners
nautec.wrench.link.cut_output: Linked, but %s no longer sends its old beam. Junctions split beams
nautec.wrench.link.not_in_line: %s is not in a straight line with the link start
nautec.wrench.link.start_gone: The link start block is gone, link positions cleared
nautec.wrench.link.too_far: Too far: %s blocks, the beam reaches %s
nautec.wrench.mode.fluid_sides.desc: Right-click a machine face to change its fluid mode, sneak to go back.
nautec.wrench.mode.item_sides.desc: Right-click a machine face to change its item mode, sneak to go back.
nautec.wrench.mode.link.desc: Right-click a laser source, then the block it should feed, to aim them at each other. Right-click the air to start over.
nautec.wrench.mode.rotate.desc: Right-click a machine to turn it. Also forms multiblocks and sets Laser Junction faces.
nautec.wrench.mode.switch: Sneak and right-click the air to change mode.
nautec_guide.missing_guideme: Install GuideMe to read the NauTec 2 guide
